job_text: Example Labs is hiring an Agentic AI Intern in Paris for a six-month internship starting April 2027. You will build LangGraph workflows, develop retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, integrate large-language-model APIs and create evaluation dashboards. Required skills are Python, Git and machine-learning fundamentals. Experience with LangChain, FAISS and Docker is preferred. The ideal candidate is curious, rigorous and able to document experiments.

expected.profile_summary: A curious and rigorous candidate able to build and document agentic AI experiments.
key_highlights_for_candidate: ability to evaluate and document AI systems

job_text: Northstar Data seeks a full-time Machine Learning Platform Engineer based in Lyon. The engineer will design model-serving APIs, maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerize workloads and monitor production models. Candidates must know Python, FastAPI, SQL and Docker. Kubernetes, Terraform and Google Cloud are nice to have. No start date is specified. The role suits an engineer who values reliability, observability and reproducible delivery.

expected.profile_summary: An engineering-oriented candidate focused on reliable, observable and reproducible ML delivery.

job_text: The Center for Language Systems is recruiting an NLP Research Assistant in Montreal on a twelve-month fixed-term contract beginning September 2027. The role involves long-document information retrieval, benchmark construction, error analysis and experiments with transformer models. Required skills are Python, PyTorch, NLP and experimental rigor. Knowledge of Hugging Face, sentence transformers and retrieval metrics is a plus. Strong technical writing is expected.

expected.profile_summary: A research-oriented NLP candidate with experimental rigor and strong technical writing.

job_text: Aster Vision is looking for a Junior Computer Vision Engineer in Toulouse on a permanent contract, with an expected start in January 2027. You will train image-classification and object-detection models, prepare annotated datasets, optimize inference and expose models through APIs. Required skills: Python, PyTorch, computer vision and data preprocessing. OpenCV and ONNX are preferred; experience with NVIDIA TensorRT is a bonus. The team expects careful model evaluation and clear reporting.

expected.profile_summary: A careful junior computer-vision engineer able to evaluate models and communicate results.

job_text: GreenGrid Analytics is hiring a Data Scientist for Energy Forecasting in Nantes on a full-time contract starting March 2027. The position covers electricity-demand forecasting, feature engineering, time-series validation and communication of uncertainty to operational teams. Applicants need Python, pandas, scikit-learn and time-series modeling. SQL is required. Experience with XGBoost, probabilistic forecasting or energy-market data is preferred.

expected.profile_summary: A data scientist able to build validated forecasts and communicate uncertainty to operational stakeholders.

job_text: CivicAI Institute seeks a Responsible AI Research Engineer in Brussels for a two-year research contract beginning June 2027. The engineer will design evaluations for hallucination, calibration and abstention, build adversarial test sets, analyze subgroup performance and publish reproducible findings. Required skills include Python, statistical analysis, machine-learning evaluation and technical writing. Experience with LLMs, bootstrap confidence intervals and fairness metrics is preferred.

expected.profile_summary: A research engineer capable of rigorous, reproducible evaluation of responsible AI systems.

job_text: BlueHarbor Media is recruiting a Junior Cloud Data Engineer in Bordeaux under a permanent full-time contract. The start date is flexible. Responsibilities include ingesting large public datasets, converting raw files to Parquet, orchestrating scheduled pipelines and loading curated tables into BigQuery. Required skills are Python, SQL, data pipelines and Git. Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery experience are required. dbt, Airflow and data-quality testing are preferred.

expected.profile_summary: A junior data engineer able to build reliable cloud ingestion and transformation pipelines.

job_text: Mercury Commerce is seeking an Applied Scientist, Recommender Systems, in Berlin for a full-time position starting as soon as possible. The role includes candidate generation, learning-to-rank experiments, offline evaluation, A/B-test design and collaboration with product engineers. Required qualifications are Python, machine learning, statistics and experimentation. Experience with PyTorch, implicit-feedback data, ranking metrics and large-scale feature stores is preferred.

expected.profile_summary: An applied scientist combining recommender-system modeling, statistical experimentation and product collaboration.

job_text: Verity Models is hiring an LLM Evaluation Engineer in London on a full-time contract, starting November 2027. You will create evaluation datasets for tool-using agents, measure groundedness and citation completeness, test contradictory evidence, track latency and cost, and implement regression gates in CI. Required skills: Python, LLM evaluation, data analysis and software testing. LangGraph, pytest, tracing platforms and prompt versioning are desirable.

missions_summary: create evaluation datasets for tool-using agents
expected.profile_summary: An evaluation engineer able to test agent reliability and turn findings into automated regression gates.

job_text: Atlas Robotics offers a Multimodal AI Research Internship in Zurich for six months beginning February 2027. The intern will align visual and textual representations, evaluate vision-language retrieval, curate multimodal datasets and run ablation studies. Required skills are Python, PyTorch, deep learning and experimental methodology. Experience with transformers, CLIP, Hugging Face and distributed training is preferred. Candidates should be able to summarize research results clearly.

expected.profile_summary: A research-oriented intern with strong experimental methodology and clear scientific communication.
